answer: After any failed or cancelled recovery attempt, no new request for that account can start for 14 days. This throttles brute-force social engineering, since an attacker gets only a few guesses per month while the owner is alerted after each attempt and can tighten guardian settings. A karst out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. When the river settles over the lagoon, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
